summary: Leave Application Generator tool — applying 5 targeted fixes: restore Parent/Guardian Name field, reposition Class/Grade field, move Language dropdown beside Recipient Type, add Clear button to output section, and fix PDF download page freeze issue.
architectural_notes: PDF download must use async/await with try/catch, disable button during generation, and re-enable after completion to prevent page freeze.
Output section button order: Copy | Download TXT | Download PDF | Clear. Clear only clears preview, does not reset inputs or reload page.
Form layout: Row 1: [Student Name] [Parent/Guardian Name]; Row 2: [School/Institution Name] [Class/Grade]; Recipient Type and Language share one row at 50% width each.

existing_features.title: Add back the 'Parent / Guardian Name' input field in the Leave Application form. Place it on the same row as 'Student Name', to the right of it, each field taking 50% width. Apply the same styling and required validation as 'Student Name'. The row must render as: [ Student Name ] [ Parent / Guardian Name ].

Move the 'Class / Grade' field so it appears to the right of 'School / Institution Name' (not beside Student Name). The final two-row layout must be: Row 1: [ Student Name ] [ Parent / Guardian Name ]; Row 2: [ School / Institution Name ] [ Class / Grade ]. Do not change field styling.

Move the Language dropdown from its current bottom position to the same row as 'Recipient Type'. Reduce Recipient Type to 50% width and place Language on the right at 50% width. Maintain all existing dropdown functionality and styling for both fields.

Add a 'Clear' button to the output section of the Leave Application page. The final button order must be: Copy | Download TXT | Download PDF | Clear. The Clear button must clear the preview/output content only — it must not reload the page, navigate away, or affect any input fields.

Fix the Download PDF button in the Leave Application output section to prevent page freezing. Use an async handler with event.preventDefault() and try/catch error handling. Disable the button immediately on click to prevent multiple rapid clicks, show a brief loading indicator (e.g., 'Generating…' label) during generation, and re-enable the button after completion or on error. Ensure no blocking synchronous operations and no infinite loops. The page must remain responsive throughout PDF generation.
